result.stdout:
USAGE:
    agentblazor [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

EXAMPLES:
    agentblazor init
    agentblazor init ./MySolution.sln
    agentblazor init --description My app description
    agentblazor analyze
    agentblazor analyze ./MySolution.slnx --host MyBlazorApp

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help       Prints help information   
    -v, --version    Prints version information

COMMANDS:
    init        Initialize AgentBlazor for an existing Blazor app and show the  
                next installer steps                                            
    analyze     Analyze an existing Blazor app and write a read-only markdown   
                report                                                          
    update      Regenerate AGENT.md if code has changed                         
    watch       Watch for file changes and auto-regenerate                      
    doctor      Inspect an existing Blazor app for baseline AgentBlazor wiring  
    validate    Validate an AgentBlazor install using readiness checks plus     
                scaffold audit data when available                              
    scaffold    Preview the baseline AgentBlazor install edits for an existing  
                Blazor app

result.stdout:
DESCRIPTION:
Analyze an existing Blazor app and write a read-only markdown report

USAGE:
    agentblazor analyze [path] [OPTIONS]

EXAMPLES:
    agentblazor analyze
    agentblazor analyze ./MySolution.slnx --host MyBlazorApp
    agentblazor analyze ./MySolution.slnx --output .agentblazor/analysis.md

ARGUMENTS:
    [path]    Path to solution, project, or directory. Defaults to the current  
              directory                                                         

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help                     Prints help information                      
        --host <PROJECT>           Name of the Blazor host project              
                                   (auto-detected if not specified)             
        --output <PATH>            Path to write the markdown report. Defaults  
                                   to .agentblazor/analysis.md next to the      
                                   solution or project                          
        --framework <FRAMEWORK>    Framework override. v1 currently supports    
                                   'auto' and 'blazor'                          
        --no-readiness             Skip AgentBlazor install-readiness checks in 
                                   the report                                   
        --static-only              Skip the LLM workflow suggestion call and    
                                   write a static-analysis-only report          
        --scan-scope <SCOPE>       Projects to scan: 'references' scans the host
                                   project plus project references; 'solution'  
                                   scans every project in the solution          
    -y, --non-interactive          Skip interactive prompts and use defaults

result.stdout:
DESCRIPTION:
Preview the baseline AgentBlazor install edits for an existing Blazor app

USAGE:
    agentblazor scaffold [path] [OPTIONS]

EXAMPLES:
    agentblazor scaffold
    agentblazor scaffold ./MySolution.slnx --host MyBlazorApp
    agentblazor scaffold ./MySolution.slnx --host MyBlazorApp --provider openai 
--diff
    agentblazor scaffold ./MySolution.slnx --host MyBlazorApp --provider openai 
--approve

ARGUMENTS:
    [path]    Path to solution (.sln/.slnx) or project (.csproj) file

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help                       Prints help information                    
        --host <PROJECT>             Name of the Blazor host project            
                                     (auto-detected if not specified)           
        --dry-run                    Preview the proposed edits without mutating
                                     any files                                  
        --approve                    Apply the standard-host scaffold edits     
        --diff                       Show exact file-level scaffold diffs       
        --use-local-source <PATH>    Use local AgentBlazor source projects      
                                     instead of the AgentBlazor package         
                                     reference                                  
        --provider <PROVIDER>        Scaffold provider registration: openai,    
                                     azure-openai, or ollama                    
    -y, --non-interactive            Skip interactive prompts and use defaults
